crafts.name: Mini Parachute
instructions: Cut off the handles and bottom of the plastic bag, leaving two flat sheets of plastic
Take one sheet and fold it into a triangle. Repeat this folding process three times
Cut the top of the folded triangle into a curved shape. When unfolded, the plastic should have a rounded parachute-like shape
Carefully poke a small hole near the top of each corner
Cut several pieces of thread to the same length and thread them through the holes
Tie the ends of the threads together around a pen cap or another small object with a similar weight
Your craft should now look like a mini parachute!
Loosely wrap the pen cap in the plastic parachute. Toss it gently into the air and watch it slowly float down like a real parachute!
crafts.sustainability_note: The lightweight plastic sheet catches air as it falls, slowing the parachute down and allowing it to gently float toward the ground.
environmental_benefits: Reuses a plastic bag that might otherwise end up in a landfill
Shows younger kids how everyday materials can be reused
Promotes responsible consumption by giving old materials a new purpose

crafts.name: Plastic Bag Wind Spinner
instructions: Cut off the handles and bottom of the plastic bag so that you have a flat sheet of plastic
Cut the plastic into a large square
Use a marker to draw colorful patterns, lines, or shapes on the plastic
Cut the square into long, thin strips, leaving a small section in the middle uncut so the strips stay connected
Carefully twist or curl the strips so they can move and spin in the air
Attach a piece of string to the center of the wind spinner using tape
Tie the other end of the string to a small stick, straw, or pencil
Take your wind spinner outside and hold it up in a gentle breeze
Watch as the plastic strips move and spin in the wind!
crafts.sustainability_note: Moving air pushes against the lightweight plastic strips, causing them to twist, move, and spin. This demonstrates how wind energy can make objects move.
environmental_benefits: Reuses a plastic bag that might otherwise end up in a landfill
Gives old plastic a new purpose instead of throwing it away
Encourages younger kids to think creatively about recycling and reuse
Promotes responsible consumption by showing that everyday materials can become something fun and useful
